official.deadline_central_display: 15 July 2026 (latest closing date of the 2026/2027 cycle: Programa AFRICA-MED Master; the round closed at 23:59:59 Madrid time)
official.deadline_note: Each sub-programme sets its own window and deadline, and most ran only 10 working days from publication of the extract in the Boletin Oficial del Estado. 2026/2027 closing dates published on the official pages: Programa ESCUELA DIPLOMATICA 3 June 2026; Programa COE and ROMA/ROMAUE/ROMAIB residencies 3 June 2026; Programa COOPERACION and Programa CULT 2 December 2025; Lectorados 13-30 January 2026 (new/vacant) and 22-29 April 2026 (renewals starting December 2026 / January 2027); Programa AFRICA-MED Master 15 July 2026.
official.application_cycle: Convocatoria 2026/2027 (all sub-programmes closed as of 2026-10-10; the 2027/2028 round had not yet been published)
official.status_note: Every sub-programme in the Convocatoria 2026/2027 is marked "Plazo cerrado" on the official AECID pages. No 2027/2028 sub-programme had been opened as of 2026-10-10, so nothing in this family is currently accepting applications.
official.tuition_coverage_note: The official pages describe the award for Programa ESCUELA DIPLOMATICA and Programa AFRICA-MED Master as a monthly stipend plus health insurance in Spain; no official page states that master's tuition or enrolment fees are paid. The Roma residencies are not academic degrees and their published award is monthly stipend, accommodation and production expenses.
benefits: Programa ESCUELA DIPLOMATICA and Programa AFRICA-MED Master: "Dotacion mensual: 1.500 euros"
Health insurance in Spain for illnesses not contracted before the start of the scholarship, under the AECID's policy with the insurer (policy value up to 80 euros per month per beneficiary)
Roma/ROMAUE/ROMAIB residencies: monthly stipend according to the programme chosen, individual accommodation at the Academia de Espana en Roma without meals, and production expenses
Programa COOPERACION and Programa CULT: monthly stipend plus "alta en la Seguridad Social" (registration with the Spanish Social Security system)
Programa COE (up to twelve grants): total award of 23,500.00 EUR, paid in tranches
eligibility: Programa ESCUELA DIPLOMATICA and Programa AFRICA-MED Master: nationality of a listed Latin American, African, Middle Eastern, Philippine or Ukrainian country, with no dual nationality with Spain or any EU member state
No residence permit in Spain and no current or past residence in any EU country including Spain; applicants holding refugee status granted by Spain under Law 12/2009 are excepted
Programa ESCUELA DIPLOMATICA and Programa AFRICA-MED Master: permanent (non-temporary) civil servant or public employee of the applicant's own country

Licenciado/Grado university degree meeting the admission requirements of the target master's, or, for the residencies, the qualification stated for each speciality ("Sin Titulacion" is published for Roma)
Programa COE, COOPERACION, CULT and Lectorados: Spanish nationality only
Roma/ROMAUE/ROMAIB residencies: Spanish, EU (except Spanish) or Ibero-American nationality
Programme-specific age ceilings stated in each Convocatoria (for example Programa COE: age not over 27 at 31/12/2026)
requirements: Applications must be filed telematicamente through the AECID Electronic Office; an application submitted by any non-telematic route is treated as not submitted
Applicants must be registered in the Carpeta del Ciudadano before the window opens; the application form is only visible during the application period
The application window closes at 23:59:59 hours, Madrid time, on the closing day
Programa ESCUELA DIPLOMATICA and Programa AFRICA-MED Master: knowledge of Spanish must be accredited, unless the applicant is a national of a Spanish-speaking country
Where the target master's is taught in a language other than Spanish, documentary proof of that language is required
Documentation must be presented in Spanish; documents in another language must be accompanied by a Spanish translation (an official/sworn translation is not required)
Programa ESCUELA DIPLOMATICA: a valid passport of the applicant's nationality, permanent public-sector employment, and authorisation from the competent line manager for study abroad
Information entered in the electronic form cannot be corrected or amended once the application has been sent and signed
documents: Copy of the applicant's valid national passport
Curriculum vitae developed on a single page (accrediting documents may be demanded a posteriori)
Proof of the contractual relationship or dependency with the public body of employment (the contract must not be of a temporary nature)
Authorisation from the competent hierarchical superior to grant leave for the study period abroad
Proof of admission to the master's for the 2026-2027 academic year, or proof of having submitted the admission application, as required by the programme
Document accrediting knowledge of Spanish, unless a national of a Spanish-speaking country
Where the master's is taught in another language, proof of knowledge of that language
Electronic certificate (certificado electronico) of a natural person issued by a recognised certification authority, to sign and submit the application
selection_criteria: Selection rules and scoring are set out in each programme's own Convocatoria (including Apartado 6 and the annexes); the umbrella page does not publish a common scoring scheme
Language certificates are only accepted if they appear in the tables of official certificates in ANEXO III of the Convocatoria
Programa COOPERACION and CULT: a higher accredited language level increases the score, though no minimum level is required to apply
Programa COE: the AECID participates in the College of Europe selection committee, but admission and pre-selection for interview are decisions of the College of Europe
Roma residencies: projects are assessed on description, motivation, ties with Italy or the RAER, target audience, timetable, and the amounts requested with their breakdown
coverage: Programa ESCUELA DIPLOMATICA and Programa AFRICA-MED Master: "Dotacion mensual: 1.500 euros" - a monthly stipend
Seguro de asistencia sanitaria en Espana para enfermedades no contraidas con anterioridad al inicio de la beca (health insurance in Spain, policy value up to 80 euros per month)
Roma residencies: accommodation at the Academia de Espana en Roma without meals, plus gastos de produccion (production expenses)
Programa COOPERACION and Programa CULT: alta en la Seguridad Social (Social Security registration)
Programa COE: 23,500.00 EUR in total, paid in three tranches (9,800.00 EUR in September 2026, 11,600.00 EUR in January 2027, 2,100.00 EUR in June 2027)
application_method: Register in the Carpeta del Ciudadano of the AECID Electronic Office using "Altas de nuevos usuarios" and confirm the registration link sent by e-mail
During the published application window, log in and select the open call (for example the call for the Escuela Diplomatica or the Roma residencies)
Complete the electronic form, attaching each required document into its own upload box as a single PDF
Sign the application with an electronic certificate of a natural person, then submit
Confirm the filing by opening Mis Expedientes, selecting the application file and viewing the justificante de registro under Documentos
official.application_route: Online only through the AECID Electronic Office citizen folder; an electronic certificate is required to sign and no paper or e-mail alternative exists.
official.study_mode: Full-time and in person: the master's programmes are masters universitarios oficiales de caracter presencial in Spain, and the Roma awards are full-time residencies of four to nine consecutive months.
official.citizenship_residency: Programa ESCUELA DIPLOMATICA and Programa AFRICA-MED Master require nationality of a listed country and expressly exclude residence in Spain or in any EU country, including any past residence; the young-Spaniards programmes and the Lectorados require Spanish nationality; the Roma residencies are open to Spanish, EU (other than Spanish) and Ibero-American nationals.
official.international_eligibility: Yes for citizens of the listed Latin American, African, Middle Eastern, Philippine and Ukrainian countries under Programa ESCUELA DIPLOMATICA and Programa AFRICA-MED Master, and for EU (other than Spanish) and Ibero-American citizens under the Roma residencies; the young-Spaniards programmes and the Lectorados are restricted to Spanish nationals.
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Programa AFRICA-MED Master: an official in-person university master's in Spain of at most 60 ECTS. Programa ESCUELA DIPLOMATICA: the Master Interuniversitario en Diplomacia y Relaciones Internacionales of the Escuela Diplomatica. Programa COE: a master's at the College of Europe, for which the applicant must have been admitted. Programa COOPERACION and CULT: training placements in the Spanish cooperation offices (OCE), Centros de Formacion (CF) and Centros Culturales (CC) of the cooperation network. Roma/ROMAUE/ROMAIB: artistic and research residencies in the published specialities at the Real Academia de Espana en Roma. ESCUELA DIPLOMATICA and AFRICA-MED additionally require permanent public-sector employment.
official.research_requirement: The Roma artistic and research residencies require a project entered directly in the application form: description, motivation, links with Italy or the RAER, target audience, detailed timetable, the amounts requested with their breakdown, and links to the applicant's own work. The master's programmes require no research proposal, but they do require admission to the target master's.
official.duration: Varies by sub-programme: Roma residencies are four to nine months, always consecutive and within 1 October 2026 to 30 June 2027; Programa AFRICA-MED Master funds an official in-person Spanish master's of up to 60 ECTS; the Programa COE award runs from September 2026 to June 2027; Programa COOPERACION and CULT run over published destinations listed in ANEXO I and ANEXO II.
official.description: The Becas Cooperacion Espanola MAEC-AECID programme family is run by the Spanish Agency for International Development Cooperation (AECID) and funds training for Spanish citizens and for citizens of Spanish-cooperation partner countries, both in Spain and abroad. The official page groups the round into four blocks: scholarships for young Spaniards, readerships for Spaniards teaching Spanish in foreign universities, scholarships for citizens of Latin America, Africa and Asia, and artistic or research residencies at the Real Academia de Espana en Roma. Awards are financial support - a monthly stipend plus, for some programmes, health insurance, Social Security registration, accommodation or production expenses - and the official pages reviewed do not state that tuition fees are paid.
official.region: Europe (Spain), with the Roma residencies held in Italy and the Lectorados based in foreign universities
official.program_type: Government scholarship programme family (umbrella of sub-programmes), partially funded

not_confirmed: Travel, installation or relocation allowance: no official page states one for any sub-programme
Tuition or enrolment-fee coverage: no official page states that tuition is paid
Exact monthly stipend amounts per destination for Programa COOPERACION and Programa CULT, which are published only in ANEXO I and ANEXO II of each Convocatoria

The exact monthly stipend of each Roma residency programme, which the pages state "according to the programme chosen" without a figure, and the exact production-expense ceiling, published only as "hasta 20.000 euros" for the round
The 2027/2028 round dates, which had not been published as of 2026-10-10
A common selection or scoring scheme across the umbrella family: scoring sits in each programme's own Convocatoria
verification.notes: The EUR 1,500 monthly figure was taken verbatim from the AECID FAQ page for the Latin America/Africa/Asia programmes, which states "Dotacion mensual: 1.500 euros" for both Programa ESCUELA DIPLOMATICA and Programa AFRICA-MED Master, and cross-checked against the young-Spaniards FAQ (COE total EUR 23,500, paid in three tranches) and the Roma residencies page. All four programme blocks of the Convocatoria 2026/2027 are marked "Plazo cerrado" on the official pages; no 2027/2028 sub-programme was open.

applicant_utility.summary: The doors of this family that are open to international applicants are the ESCUELA DIPLOMATICA and AFRICA-MED MASTER programmes, and both are aimed squarely at serving civil servants: you must hold a permanent, non-temporary public-sector contract and already have secured admission to the target master's before the window even opens. The published award is a EUR 1,500 monthly stipend plus health insurance in Spain, with no tuition waiver, so you still have to fund master's fees, flights and housing yourself. Every 2026/2027 sub-programme is now marked "Plazo cerrado", so treat the next round as the real target and use the waiting time to line up the master's admission and your line manager's signature.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Permanently employed civil servants from the listed Latin American, African, Middle Eastern, Philippine or Ukrainian countries who hold a university degree and want a Spanish-language master's in Spain.
application_readiness_checklist: Start master's admissions six to nine months out, because the scholarship requires proof of admission at application time and the university's own timetable is usually slower and unconnected to the AECID window
Obtain written authorisation from the line manager actually empowered to grant study leave abroad, before the window opens, and confirm the contract is classed permanent rather than temporary
Verify the target master's is an official (oficial) in-person programme in Spain worth at most 60 ECTS, and confirm it is live in the RUCT register of universities, centres and degrees
Assemble a Spanish-language evidence pack early: a certificate recognised under the tables in ANEXO III of the Convocatoria, unless you are a national of a Spanish-speaking country
Merge every document into a single PDF under 10 MB and keep the source files, since the portal allows only one file per document slot
Register in the Carpeta del Ciudadano and hold a working electronic certificate well before the window, so nothing is left to a ten-working-day race
common_rejection_risks: Applying without admission, or the admission application, already in place for the master's - the published requirements make this a hard condition, not a preference
A temporary, fixed-discontinuous or short-term public-sector contract, because the bases require permanent, non-temporary employment

Dual nationality with Spain or an EU member state, or any current or former residence in an EU country, which the published nationality rule excludes unless refugee status was granted by Spain under Law 12/2009
Documents filed without a Spanish version, or a master's above 60 ECTS or not taught in person, either of which puts the AFRICA-MED route out of reach
Oversize or wrongly formatted uploads: PDF only, a 10 MB cap per file and one file per document type, so split evidence has to be combined beforehand
Leaving registration to the final days, since the form disappears once the window closes and cannot be recovered
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Master's enrolment and registration fees, international flights and relocation, rent and day-to-day living costs beyond the EUR 1,500 monthly stipend, and, for the Rome residencies, meals since accommodation is provided without maintenance. Bank charges on transfers to foreign accounts are explicitly borne by the grant holder, and the health insurance policy covers only up to 80 euros a month.
document_audit: The CV must fit on a single page; supporting evidence can be demanded later, so a sprawling CV is an avoidable risk
The passport must be valid and in the applicant's own name, which is the document most often found expired when a ten-working-day window opens
Employment proof has to show the non-temporary character, so attach both the contract and any instrument that states permanence rather than relying on one document
The line manager's authorisation must come from the manager competent to grant leave for study abroad, not merely the immediate supervisor
One upload box per requirement means evidence split across several files has to be combined into a single PDF first

Applicants who have lived in Spain should expect positive AEAT and Social Security certificates, or an explicit electronic consent for AECID to check them, and note that certificates from Navarra, the Basque Country, Catalonia or foreign tax authorities are not accepted
alerts: Every 2026/2027 sub-programme shows "Plazo cerrado" as of 2026-10-10 and no 2027/2028 round had been published, so nothing in this family can be applied for right now

The windows are unusually short: the ESCUELA DIPLOMATICA round lasted only ten working days from publication of the extract in the Boletin Oficial del Estado, and windows close at 23:59:59 Madrid time
The application form exists only inside the window; before it opens and after it closes the form is not visible in the citizen folder at all
Submitted and signed form data is final and cannot be corrected afterwards - only attached documents can be rectified during any remedy period

Master's admission is a separate university-run process; for the Escuela Diplomatica you may additionally need the diplomatic channel or to follow Orden AUC/329/2026, and the grant is conditional on final admission
Paper, postal and e-mail submissions are treated as not presented, so there is no fallback if the portal fails at the last moment
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Register in the AECID citizen folder, wait for the specific programme's form to appear inside the published window, fill it in one sitting, attach each requirement as a single PDF, sign with an electronic certificate, then verify the filing receipt under My Files.
